criteria.evidence: Diff: `-## [Unreleased]` / `+## [0.9.0] - 2026-08-28`, with Security and Added content kept beneath it.

Every Security, Added and Housekeeping bullet ends with `([#N](https://github.com/entireio/git-sync/pull/N))` and no trailing period precedes the link (e.g. "Pulls `go-billy` to `v6.0.0-alpha.2` ([#106](...))").
Replay added a Security bullet for #104 (x/crypto bump) and a Housekeeping bullet for #105, stating it traced merge commits "since `gh` wasn't available".
Security bullets reduced from multi-sentence paragraphs to 2–3 sentences each (e.g. SSH shell-quoting bullet shrunk from ~6 sentences to 2).
All 15 Security bullets (14 original + #104) remain after compression, each retaining its PR link.

Final diff still has "Bumped go-git to `v6.0.0-alpha.5` (from the `alpha.4`-based pseudo-version picked up below)" under Security AND "Bumped `go-git` ahead of the alpha.5 security bump above" under Housekeeping; the replay cross-referenced the two rather than consolidating into one place as the user asked.
#105 cited on the Housekeeping bullet and #106 cited on the Security go-git bullet (and toolchain/Vulnerability Scan bullets).

judge.reason: The replay renamed the heading, back-filled links, added #104/#105, and compressed Security bullets while keeping every entry and link. However, when the user asked for the go-git bump to appear in only one spot, the replay kept a go-git bump bullet in both Security and Housekeeping (merely cross-referencing them), so c6 is unmet; PR attribution for several bullets (#112 vs #109–#111) also looks doubtful though no criterion directly targets it.
